title: Vampire Vape Pinkman 70/30 E-Liquid 10ml
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman is a legendary name in the vaping world, celebrated for its vibrant and multi-layered fruit profile. This 70/30 edition brings the classic recipe to sub-ohm vapers, anchored by a sweet foundation of ripe Red Berries. On the inhale, the juicy notes of Strawberry and Raspberry take centre stage, providing a naturally sweet and consistent fruit base. The experience is rounded off by the signature hints of zesty Citrus and Tropical Fruit that define the Pinkman profile. These subtle, tangy undertones balance the sweetness of the berries to ensure the flavour remains refreshing throughout the day. It is a complex fruit blend that avoids becoming overly sugary, making it an ideal choice for an all-day vape. This 10ml e-liquid is mixed with a 70VG/30PG ratio, making it an ideal choice for high-powered sub-ohm kits and tanks using low-resistance coils. The higher VG content is designed to produce dense vapour and a smooth, comfortable throat hit. Available in 0mg, 3mg, and 6mg nicotine strengths, these bottles offer a more sustainable and cost-effective alternative to single-use disposables, allowing you to enjoy this famous blend in a high-performance format.
